plan_waiting: {n} things are waiting for you to start
plan_waiting_single: Something is waiting for you to start
fixed_launcher_unhealthy: Launcher {launcher} is unavailable on fixed computer {machine}: {reason}. This task stays on that computer; retry after its health recovers.
launcher_not_on_machine: Launcher {launcher} isn’t on {machine}, so nothing was started. Launchers that computer has: {launchers}
launcher_swapped: {launcher} isn’t on {machine}, so this runs on {to} with its default model
start_identity_conflict: The start response did not identify a session on the requested computer.
start_interrupted: The hub restarted while this task’s agent was starting. The earlier request may still finish. Check the computer’s sessions after it reconnects before retrying to avoid starting a second agent.
task_failed_body: {reason}. Open the conversation to tap “Retry”, or assign to another computer
task_failed_body_no_reason: Open the conversation to tap “Retry”, or assign to another computer
not_retryable: Only a task that didn’t start, or was interrupted by a model service error, can be retried
not_in_plan: Can’t find this task’s plan, so it can’t be started again as it was
machine_offline: “{name}” is offline. Try again once it’s connected.
silent_turn: This turn had no output: the agent didn’t reply or call any tools (the model service may have returned nothing)
interrupted: Interrupted by a model service error
check_side_turn: The last reply didn’t report on this task
route_no_task: This chat doesn’t have that task
route_no_agent: This task has no running agent
adopt_failed: Could not take it under supervision: {reason}
